stories.title: Bilingual Content Completeness Validator
stories.description: Create validation script that scans all 20 CoCu files for bilingual header sections and flags any missing English-Bahasa Malaysia pairs in titles, key terms, or assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_bilingual_completeness.py scans all content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md files and outputs JSON to output/bilingual_validation_report.json listing any sections missing MS or EN translations
Report includes file path, section type (header/key-terms/assessment), missing language, and line number for quick remediation
Exit code 0 if 100% bilingual compliance, non-zero if gaps found (enables CI/CD gate)

stories.title: Contact Hour Compliance Audit Trail via Git
stories.description: Implement git-based audit trail that tags and documents each time contact hours are verified/corrected across L3/L4/L5, creating an immutable compliance record for JPK reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/audit_contact_hours.py reads git history and identifies commits touching contact hour tables, then generates output/contact_hour_audit.html timeline showing verification dates, changed values, and validator notes
Each audit entry includes commit hash, date, author, and total hours before/after for L3, L4, L5
HTML report includes certification statement confirming L3=1200 hours verified as of latest audit date

stories.title: Learning Outcome Bloom's Taxonomy Classifier
stories.description: Parse all learning outcomes from 20 CoCu files and classify each by Bloom's cognitive level (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create), outputting distribution analysis to identify gaps in cognitive depth.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/classify_bloom_taxonomy.py parses 'Learning Outcome' sections and uses regex/keyword patterns to classify statements (e.g., 'Explain' → Understand, 'Design' → Create)
Output CSV to output/bloom_classification.csv with columns: CoCu, LearningOutcome, BloomsLevel, Confidence%, and outputs HTML heatmap showing level distribution across all 20 units
Alert if any CoCu has <20% Create-level outcomes (indicates insufficient higher-order thinking targets)

stories.title: NOSS Pre-Flight Compliance Checklist Generator
stories.description: Generate an interactive HTML checklist with 25+ NOSS compliance requirements that validators can step through, with auto-population of findings from scripts and manual override capability for final sign-off.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_preflight_checklist.py produces output/noss_preflight_checklist.html with 25 checkbox items covering: bilingual headers (all 20 units), contact hours (L3=1200), assessment sections (all units), K30/P70 allocation, practical exercises, references, etc.
Checklist auto-populates 80% of checks by running validation scripts; remaining 20% require manual review (curriculum pedagogy, industry relevance)
Checklist marks submission as 'Ready' only when all 25 items checked AND all automated validation scripts pass with exit code 0

stories.title: Assessment Question Auto-Translation Validator
stories.description: Parse all assessment criteria from CoCu files, generate sample assessment questions in English, then validate that Bahasa Malaysia equivalents exist and maintain semantic fidelity (no meaning drift).
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_assessment_translations.py extracts assessment criteria from all 20 CoCu files, generates 3-5 sample questions per unit (stored in output/assessment_questions.json with EN and MS pairs)
For each MS translation, script flags high-risk terms (technical jargon, idioms) where translation quality may vary, producing output/translation_risk_report.html with confidence scores
Manual review workflow: translator updates MS versions in output/assessment_questions.json; script re-validates and confirms semantic preservation

stories.title: Employability Skills-to-ISCO-08 Mapper
stories.description: Cross-reference employability skills from all 20 CoCu files against ISCO-08 job classification to identify which real-world IT roles require the taught competencies, validating industry relevance.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/map_skills_to_isco.py parses Employability Skills sections from all CoCu files and matches against ISCO-08 job titles (e.g., 'System Administration' → ISCO code 3511), outputting output/isco_skills_mapping.json
Report includes job title, ISCO code, matching skills from CoCu, and estimated job growth (from local labor market data if available)
Flag any CoCu with <3 matching ISCO roles (indicates insufficient industry alignment)

stories.title: Contact Hour Activity Budget Timeline Generator
stories.description: Convert contact hour totals from each CoCu into realistic week-by-week and day-by-day activity budgets with activity type distribution (lecture, lab, practical, assessment), outputting interactive Excel timeline for instructors.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_activity_budgets.py reads contact hour distribution tables and creates output/activity_budget_{level}.xlsx with sheets: Weekly (26-week schedule showing hrs/week per activity type), Daily (sample week showing hrs/day), and Milestone (key assessment dates)
Excel includes pie charts showing % allocation: Knowledge (30%) vs Performance (70%), and bar charts for activity type distribution per week
Formula cells allow instructors to adjust calendar assumptions (e.g., 12-week vs 26-week delivery) and auto-recalculate hour distribution

stories.title: CoCu Skill Progression Validator (L3→L4→L5)
stories.description: Ensure learning outcomes form continuous skill progression chains across levels — L3 foundational skills feed into L4 intermediate skills feed into L5 advanced skills, with no gaps or orphaned competencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/validate_skill_progression.py parses learning outcomes from all 20 CoCu files, builds a skill dependency graph (e.g., L3 'Network Fundamentals' → L4 'Network Administration' → L5 'Network Architecture'), and outputs output/skill_progression_matrix.html
Report flags: orphaned skills (in L4/L5 but no L3 prerequisite), redundant skills (taught in multiple levels without clear progression), and jumps in complexity (L3→L5 with no L4 bridge)
HTML includes clickable skill nodes showing where each skill is taught and what downstream skills depend on it

stories.title: Equipment Specifications Standardizer with EOL Tracking
stories.description: Extract all hardware/software equipment mentions from 20 CoCu files, standardize specifications (versions, models), flag 2024-2026 end-of-life (EOL) items, and map to modern replacements.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/standardize_equipment_specs.py parses equipment tables from all CoCu files and produces output/equipment_catalog.json with: equipment name, standardized model/version, EOL date (from vendor data), replacement recommendation, and curriculum impact assessment
Report flags any equipment with EOL ≤2026 with severity (critical if used in L3 foundational skills, lower if L5 elective), and suggests 2024-2025 alternatives
Generate output/equipment_eol_summary.html showing equipment lifecycle timeline and replacement roadmap per level

stories.title: JPK Submission Readiness Dashboard
stories.description: Create single-page HTML dashboard aggregating 15+ compliance validation checks (bilingual, contact hours, learning outcomes, assessment, equipment, etc.) with traffic-light status indicators, blocking issues summary, and final sign-off gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Script scripts/generate_jpk_dashboard.py executes all validation scripts (bilingual, contact hours, Bloom's, ISCO, skill progression, equipment EOL, etc.) and consolidates results into output/jpk_submission_dashboard.html

Dashboard displays: 15+ check items with status (✅ Pass / ⚠️ Warning / ❌ Fail), timestamp of last validation run, list of 'Blocking Issues' (items that prevent submission), and overall submission readiness percentage
Dashboard includes 'Sign Off' button that generates output/jpk_submission_manifest.json with validation timestamps, approver name field, and CI/CD exit code that enables/blocks final submission
